description.value: The Shepherd's Inn is a family-owned roadside complex on the Alaska Highway at Mile 72, roughly 42 km northwest of Fort St. John, billing itself as 'An Oasis on The Alaska Highway.' The property combines a motel, full-service restaurant with to-go orders, a convenience store, and a fueling station under one roof. For northbound or southbound Alaska Highway tourers, it is a rare multi-service stop in a long, remote stretch of highway.

address.value: 11890 Shepherds Inn Frontage Road, Charlie Lake, BC V1J 8L5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an open, year-round family-run motel/restaurant/convenience store/gas station at Mile 72 of the Alaska Highway. Phone (+1-250-827-3676) and address (11890 Shepherds Inn Frontage Rd, Charlie Lake BC V1J 8L5) match OSM exactly. No mention of bike storage, Wi-Fi details, or cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site, though the on-site restaurant and convenience store are explicitly confirmed.
